Creamy Boursin Chicken Sausage Orzo Bake 🍅🌿 Such a yummy easy meal!!! 💛 Ingredients: - 1 lb orzo - 12 oz spinach & feta chicken sausage, sliced - 2 cups cherry tomatoes - 1 cup baby spinach - 3-4 garlic cloves (or minced garlic)  - 1 round Garlic & Fine Herbs Boursin cheese - 2 3/4 cups chicken broth - 1 tbsp olive oil - 2 tsp garlic powder - Salt & pepper, to taste Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F 2. Add orzo, sliced chicken sausage, cherry tomatoes, garlic and spinach to a baking dish 3. Place the Boursin cheese right in the center 4. Pour in chicken broth + drizzle olive oil over everything 5. Season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper 6. Bake for 30 minutes 7. Take it out and stir everything together until the Boursin melts into a creamy sauce 8. Let it sit 5–10 minutes so it gets extra creamy and the orzo soaks up the sauce!! thick bakery style chocolate chip cookies🍪🍫 Ingredients: 170g (3/4 cup) unsalted butter, cold and cubed 150g (3/4 cup) brown sugar 70g (1/3 cup) granulated sugar 1 egg + 1 egg yolk 2 tsp vanilla 300g (2 1/2 cups) all purpose flour 1 tbsp cornstarch 1/2 tsp baking soda 1/4 tsp baking powder 3/4 tsp salt 250g (1 1/2 cups) chocolate chips  Flakey sea salt (optional) Instructions:  1. In a large bowl, combine the butter, brown sugar, and white sugar. Mix until smooth and well combined. Do not cream. 2. Add the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla, then mix until fully incorporated. 3. Add the dry ingredients (flour, cornstarch, baking powder, baking soda, and salt) and fold until just combined. 4. Fold in the chocolate chips or chunks until evenly distributed. Do not overmix. 5. Divide the dough into 150g portions and shape each into a rough ball. 6. Place the dough balls on a lined tray, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight. 7. Bake in a preheated 190°C (375°F) oven for 13-16 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are still slightly soft. 8. Allow the cookies to cool on the baking tray for a few minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. If desired, sprinkle with flaky sea salt and let cool for about 15 minutes before serving. Enjoy! Note: This recipe made 6 cookies weighing 150g each and 1 cookie weighing 100g🍪🤎 #baking #cookies #chocolatechipcookies #Recipe #nyccookies

Making Cheesesteak Egg rolls in my room! 🧀🥩 — They kinda turned into squares but either way they weren’t hard to make and were so yummy 🤤  Ingredients: • White onion • Green bell pepper • Red bell pepper • Shredded steak • Egg roll wraps • Mozzarella cheese • Provolone cheese • Eggs • Garlic powder • Onion powder • Smoked paprika • Salt & Pepper • Frying oil Instructions: - Chop white onion, green bell pepper, and red bell pepper - Add oil to a pan and sweat down  chopped veggies - Add one pack of shredded steak to the pan, stir the meat and veggies until about 50% cooked - Add garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt and pepper. Mix well. - Cover in a layer of shredded mozzarella cheese, stirring into the meat. Turn off heat and remove meat/ peppers/cheese - Place down a wonton/eggroll wrap with a slice of provolone cheese in the center. Add cheesesteak filling, and more mozzarella cheese on top - Line the inside edges with whisked egg wash, and begin folding the corners in. Roll and pat to make sure they are closed. - Heat frying oil in a pot, and fry for 3-4 minutes each egg roll, then place on a paper towel - Plate with sweet and spicy sauce, ranch, cheese sauce, or any other sauce you want! #cheesesteak #eggrolls #EasyRecipe #Foodie #lazypot

Toutes les croquettes ne se valent pas. 👀 Un réflexe simple : regarde la liste des ingrédients. Si les céréales (blé, maïs, riz…) apparaissent en tête de liste, ce n’est généralement pas le meilleur choix. Privilégie plutôt des croquettes avec des protéines animales clairement identifiées et détaillées : poulet, saumon, dinde… plutôt que des termes vagues comme « viandes et sous-produits animaux ». Une bonne composition, c’est souvent : ✅ Des protéines bien sourcées et en quantité suffisante ✅ Des ingrédients transparents ✅ Peu ou pas de céréales en tête de liste Ton animal mérite une alimentation de qualité. ❤️🐾 ⚠️ Chaque animal est différent. bakery style oreo stuffed cookies 🍪🥛    recipe: ingredients: ¾ cup salted butter, softened (170 g) ¾ cup packed brown sugar (150 g) ¼ cup granulated sugar (50 g) 1 large egg  1 tsp vanilla (5 g) 2 cups all-purpose flour (240 g) 1 tbsp cornstarch (8 g) ½ tsp baking soda (3 g) ¼ tsp salt (1.5 g) oreos, some whole some  roughly chopped  white chocolate (measure with your heart)  & choceur cookie and cream chocolate’s   instructions: cream the butter and sugars together  until smooth and slightly fluffy. mix in the egg and vanilla until fully combined. in a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking soda, and salt. fold the dry ingredients into the wet just until combined.  chop some of the oreos into small chunks ( leave some for topping ) and fold them in along with the white chocolate. scoop the dough into 8 portions, flatten and add an oreo inside and chocolate then shape into tall mounds. ( i flatten the top but keep them tall ) bake at 375°F for 11–14 minutes, until the edges are set and the centers are still soft. ( baking time may vary ) let cool to set the cookies!  i added moser roths white chocolate to the bottom & inside !    #oreo #cookies #chocolatechipcookies #Recipe #baking
